name: Track employee expenses from receipt photos on Telegram with GPT-4o-mini vision, policy checks, manager approval and monthly reports

parameters.content:
## Track employee expenses from receipt photos on Telegram with GPT-4o-mini vision, policy checks, manager approval and monthly reports

### How it works

An employee sends a receipt photo to your Telegram bot. GPT-4o-mini reads merchant, date, total, currency, tax and category from the picture; a Code node cleans the values. Two Merge nodes apply your rules from a Google Sheet: the Policy tab (limit per receipt, approval threshold, allowed categories) and the Expenses tab (same claim already recorded). A Switch auto-approves claims within policy, blocks duplicates, bounces unreadable photos, rejects non-reimbursable categories and sends the rest to the manager on Telegram with Approve / Reject buttons. Every claim lands in the Expenses tab, the employee gets the decision in the chat, approved receipts are forwarded to the finance chat, and on the 1st a monthly report goes out by Gmail.

### Setup steps

- Create a Google Sheet with the tabs Policy and Expenses (columns in the section notes) and paste its ID into the Sheets nodes.
- Connect Telegram (bot from @BotFather), OpenAI, Google Sheets and Gmail; set the manager and finance chat IDs and the finance email.
- Fill the Policy tab with your categories and limits, then send the bot a test receipt.

### Customization

Change the categories in the prompt and Code node, the 60-day age limit, or swap Telegram for Slack.

## 1. Receive receipts on Telegram

The trigger downloads the largest photo size of every message to the bot. Messages without a picture get a short reminder. The submission fields (who, when, caption, file id) are kept for the sheet and the replies.

## 2. Read the receipt with AI

The OpenAI node sends the image to GPT-4o-mini with a strict JSON instruction. The Code node parses the answer, normalises dates (12.09.2026, 09/12/2026, 12 Sep 2026), amounts (1.250,00 / 1,250.00) and currency symbols, maps the category to your list and builds the duplicate key. If the call fails, the employee is asked to retry and nothing is recorded.

## 3. Apply the expense policy

Policy tab columns: Category, LimitPerReceipt, ApprovalAbove, Allowed, Notes (leave ApprovalAbove empty for no approval, 0 to always ask). Expenses tab columns: SubmittedAt, Employee, TelegramUserId, ChatId, Merchant, Date, Amount, Currency, Tax, Category, Description, Status, Decision, DecisionNote, ReceiptFileId, Month.
The first Merge attaches the policy row of the receipt's category, the second finds an identical claim already recorded. The Switch routes: auto-approve, duplicate, missing info, not allowed (category or over the limit), or needs approval (above the threshold, unknown category, older than 60 days or low AI confidence).

## 4. Approve, record and reply

Claims that need a decision go to the manager on Telegram with Approve / Reject buttons; the workflow waits up to 3 days. All outcomes meet in one place, are appended to the Expenses tab, and the employee gets the result as a reply in the chat. Approved receipts are forwarded as photos to the finance chat, so the bookkeeper has the evidence next to the sheet.

## 5. Monthly expense report

On the 1st the approved expenses of the previous month are read from the sheet, totalled per employee and per category (per currency) and emailed as an HTML table via Gmail.

### 🚀 Want the full expense process?

This template is the safe starting point. I build extended versions for real businesses: **mileage and per-diem rules**, multi-currency conversion, **Google Drive archive** of every receipt, reimbursement batches with **bank payment files**, QuickBooks or Xero export, Slack or WhatsApp instead of Telegram.

Async delivery, no calls - contact links in my creator profile.
